entries.product: Beazley Breach Response (BBR) 5.0 / Full Spectrum Cyber
entries.title: Beazley Breach Response 5.0
entries.notes: Specimen policy form hosted by a membership association (BIG IMD), not by Beazley. A search snippet gave the form number and edition as F00653 02/2025, but it was unclear whether it referred to this file; not checked against the document itself. BBR 5.0 is the current US wording (new BBR version for new and renewal accounts incepting 1 July 2025, surplus and admitted paper, subject to state approval). US small business version is sold via myBeazley for revenue under $35M and limits up to $5M.
